steps.code:
# Get all sent transactions for May 2023
access_token = venmo_login['access_token']
all_transactions = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=access_token,
        min_created_at='2023-05-01',
        max_created_at='2023-05-31',
        direction='sent',
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=20
    )
    if not page:
        break
    all_transactions.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

print(f"Number of sent transactions in May: {len(all_transactions)}")
print(all_transactions)
